summary: Round 2 review of the input bookkeeping change at 8b7b9ffc0. The sole round-1 blocker IBK-R1-01 (missing native evidence) is closed by notes/sim10_input_bookkeeping_20261110/native/attempt03: gpu-tests.json records 31 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, exit 0 across the six device/integration files, run against the three-file overlay with an import-path assertion; baseline-check.json reproduces the exact stale BeginStep assertion failure (array(1.) == 2 at frozen test line 79) on the unchanged install-B gpu_events.py whose sha256 cfc6b2bb... equals the 'old' overlay hash and perlmutter-runtime.json; complete.json is status pass with all 12 matched cases; slurm.txt shows job 61098604 COMPLETED 0:0 for the batch step and all 14 srun steps (baseline, tests, 12 cases); provenance.json ties git_head b95b789ca and the three source file hashes to the overlay 'new' hashes. Each inspected clean receipt shows 50000 requests, 33582000000 requested and completed bytes, pressure_drains 0, cpu_reads 0, cleanup_complete true on all ranks, drain closed/0/0/0, zero initial resident pages, framework batch 100 / 512 KiB / 6 GiB / SMD 1000, correct stream count, same host nid003900, same GPU UUID and affinity; old-variant BD rows resolve all ten modules to frozen install-B while new rows resolve only the three changed modules to the overlay with hashes matching the checkout source hashes in provenance. The accepted validator (sim10_trace campaign.validate) plus runtime_identity.validate fail closed per case. Measured results support the reported improvement: clean medians 2-stream 1.2656 -> 2.1841 GiB/s (+72.6%, elapsed 24.71 -> 14.32 s), 1-stream 2.2302 -> 2.2871 GiB/s; timing runs show input.poll calls 50101 -> 101 and 2-stream exclusive poll time 9.22 s -> 0.18 s with issue bookkeeping 2.71 s -> 0.47 s, while reader group bookkeeping is unchanged as stated. README arithmetic reproduces from summary.json. All four non-blocking round-1 responses are verified in code: IBK-R1-02 test_raw_hold_release_failure_preserves_candidate_and_busy_slot_until_retry asserts state survives in _groups/_candidates/_busy_slots with hold count 1 then reclaims once; IBK-R1-03 comment at gpu_events.py:834-836; IBK-R1-04 bind registers notify_when_retirable before assigning state.window with a duplicate-registration test; IBK-R1-05 trace_runner inventory records only wrapped methods and the phases.json inventories for old (poll, plan_slots, issue) and new (poll, plan_slots, issue_groups, _issue_reserved) match the installed wrappers. Runtime re-inspection found no regressions: busy set and candidates are maintained only alongside live ownership; notification fires once under the window lock only when closed and unreferenced and the callback only enqueues; _collect_candidates rejects stale states by identity; failed CUDA query or release leaves the candidate for retry; issue_groups validates keys/slots/credits before any I/O and partial submissions remain pool-owned since wait_batch does not consult the reader poison flag; standalone issue() preserved; no read sizes, grouping, credits, batching or CUDA scheduling changes. The corrected integration test matches production _dispatch_transition, which retains constants per run and increments _step_generation only on BeginStep. CPU log records 970 passed. One new low, non-blocking documentation finding.
